title: Ranveer Singh Crashed Anshula Kapoor's Wedding Reception. The DJ Knew Exactly What to Play.
excerpt: With a pregnant Deepika at home, Bollywood's biggest party-starter showed up alone, dodged every paparazzo, and turned the Kapoor reception into a Gunday reunion nobody saw coming.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Ranveer Singh attended Anshula Kapoor's wedding reception solo, creating a buzz in Bollywood.
  • The reception featured a star-studded guest list, including Alia Bhatt and Rekha.
  • Ranveer and Arjun Kapoor recreated their iconic dance from 'Gunday', energizing the crowd.
  • Anshula's wedding included a heartfelt tribute to their late mother, Mona Shourie Kapoor.
  • The event highlighted the evolving dynamics of Bollywood's first families amidst personal milestones.

The DJ dropped the first few notes of the *Dhurandhar* title track, and the room knew before they saw him. Ranveer Singh had arrived.

Anshula Kapoor and screenwriter Rohan Thakkar got married on July 6 in an intimate ceremony in Mumbai. Two days later, the family hosted a reception that brought out half of Bollywood — but it was Ranveer, arriving without his pregnant wife Deepika Padukone, slipping past every paparazzo with a wall of security, who turned the evening into the most talked-about party of the year.

The Gunday Are Back

![Alia Bhatt — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e8/Alia_Bhatt_attends_at_the_2026_Cannes_Film_Festival_%28cropped%29_%28cropped%29.jpg)

Once inside, all pretense of discretion evaporated. The DJ cued up Dhurandhar tracks. Ranveer responded the only way he knows how — by taking over the dance floor and daring everyone to keep up. But the real moment came when Arjun Kapoor joined him, and the pair launched into a full-blown recreation of *"Tune Maari Entriyaan"* from *Gunday* (2014). Bikram and Bala, twelve years later, still electric.

> "Bollywood parties are incomplete without the OG party starter." — Fan reaction on X after videos surfaced of Ranveer's entrance

> "But the real moment came when Arjun Kapoor joined him, and the pair launched into a full-blown recreation of *"Tune Maari Entriyaan"* from *Gunday* (2014)."

Singer Himesh Reshammiya performed live, and because no Ranveer appearance is ever halfway, both he and Arjun jumped on stage to belt out *"Mujhko Yaad Sataye Teri"* alongside Himesh. The videos are everywhere. The energy is unmistakable.

A-List, Head to Toe

![Arjun Kapoor — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Arjun_Kapoor_at_film_promotions_of_Mubarakan.jpg)

The guest list read like a Filmfare invite. Alia Bhatt, Rekha (in a saree dripping with jewels, naturally), Bobby Deol, Varun Dhawan, Jackie Shroff, Bhumi Pednekar, Rakul Preet Singh — they were all there. The Kapoor clan turned out in full force: Janhvi Kapoor in a saree with heavy kundan jewellery, Anil Kapoor in head-to-toe black looking like the man hasn't aged since *Race*, Shanaya Kapoor in silver-gold, and Riteish Deshmukh with Genelia D'Souza. Add Boney Kapoor, Sanjay Kapoor, Khushi Kapoor, and Chunky Panday with wife Bhavana, and you had a reception that doubled as an unofficial industry reunion.

The Bride, the Brother, and the Portrait

Anshula looked stunning in a coral-and-gold lehenga with emerald and kundan jewellery, while Rohan complemented her in an ivory-gold sherwani and matching turban. But the most affecting detail was quieter: a framed portrait of Mona Shourie Kapoor, Anshula and Arjun's late mother, placed at the ceremony so her presence could be felt throughout the celebrations. Anshula's personalised kaleeras added another intimate touch to what was already a deeply personal affair.

Arjun's social media post after the wedding cut through all the noise: *"To my Ansh, you will always be mine, but now the time has come for me to let you go on a new path. Never worry, because Maa is always watching over you and blessing you every moment. I am always with you, always there for you."*

Anshula's own words were just as moving: *"Among so many people, in so many places, and through so many good and bad times, it was you. And through every turn, every up and down, and every unexpected journey of life. It's still you."*

Why the Diaspora Cares

The Kapoors are Bollywood royalty in a way that transcends borders. For NRIs who grew up on Anil Kapoor's *Mr. India* and Boney Kapoor's productions, who followed Arjun's career from *Ishaqzaade* to the Dhurandhar franchise, and who watched Anshula carve her own path with the charity initiative Fankind — this wedding felt personal. It was tradition meeting spectacle, grief meeting joy, and family holding the centre through all of it.

Emotional Moments at the Wedding
›Anshula wore a stunning coral-and-gold lehenga.
›Rohan complemented her in an ivory-gold sherwani.
›A portrait of their late mother was displayed.
›Arjun's heartfelt message emphasized family bonds.
›Anshula expressed gratitude for her journey.

The reception also underscored something the diaspora tracks closely: the shifting dynamics of Bollywood's first families. With Deepika expecting their second child, Ranveer juggling the *Pralay* shoot and *Dhurandhar*'s Japan release, and Arjun stepping into an emotionally protective big-brother role, the evening captured a generation of stars in transition — still glamorous, still magnetic, but growing into something more grounded.

Ranveer, for his part, didn't need a red carpet to steal the show. He just needed a dance floor and a DJ who knew the assignment.
